description: C-47A-15-DK c/n 12715 (USAAF 42-92867), Mexican AF 1947, converted to executive DC-3 in 1956, LKB Resources survey aircraft with a MAD tail boom; seized by the Dirección Nacional de Estupefacientes and preserved immaculately at the school as a classroom. Identity confirmed 2008-10; photographed 2008 - still-present status not re-verified.
museum_name: Colegio De La Salle DC-3, Bogotá
